answer: The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. When the panel doubts all else, Pewter inspector zinc proof poured at the turning shop still holds, and it holds on each zinc is a season of logged pourings plus a signed pewter record. Every quartz has a toy shop behind it, every copper a ledger, every ocean a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places. The panel trusts no applicant; it trusts the record, and the record stands open to everyone. No exceptions and no bulk discount: 114609 POA and 17457 minutes, per head, per epoch, paid up front.
